craft_notes: Sthāyin: iteration. Sanskrit-first: pratitattvam as station-beat. Rows: 2. Close: old telling. Rejected: modernizing svāhā — killed: fire-word keeps the rite audible. Read aloud: bead-count cadence.

lines: Fire-word each station, full flame fed;
all spells the same — or as the old ones said.
l4.sanskrit_cite: svāheti pratitattvaṃ syācchuddhe pūrṇāhutiṃ kṣipet | evaṃ mantrāntaraiḥ kuryātsamastairathavoktavat
